questions.question:
안내원이 Ⓐ의 'You must not use the flash.'라고 말한 이유는? [4점]
[In the art museum]
M: Everybody, look over here, please. This is Sun Flowers by Van Gogh.
G: Wow, this is my favorite painting. May I take a picture of it?
M: Yes, you may, but Ⓐ<u>you must not use the flash</u>.
G: Why not? It's a little dark in here.
M: I'm sorry, but using the flash can damage paintings.
G: Oh, I didn't know that.
M: Everyone, we'll move on to Monet's paintings next.
G: Great.   (M: 안내원  G: 소녀)
choices: ① Because other people don't like the flash.
② Because it is too dark inside the museum.
③ Because using the flash is not good for paintings.
④ Because they have to move on to the next room.
⑤ Because they must not take pictures inside the room.
